title: Serving Benchmark Request
description: What a serving benchmark ran (bench_request.json; onboarding returns it as output_files.bench_request). Run the same client_args against a changed server and the two summaries differ only by the change. tpu-serving-bench reads it as a workload and adds the image's ordered patch list and the slot hardware key it ran on.

client_args.description: serving_benchmark.py's arguments, verbatim (for a sweep, those after `--`), without --base-url and --output-dir.

server.description: The server measured (a sweep's leader): job_id, and when known compute_profile, image, deployments_json, launch_recipe.

patches.description: vllm_torchtpu patch paths the server applied, in apply order; absent or empty for the bare image.

hardware.description: The tpu_slots.py hardware key every server ran on, when one was pinned.

sweep.description: sweep only: what serving_sweep.py run was given besides client_args (sweep_plan, recipe, server_inputs, max_model_len).

results_json.description: Path to the client's summary.json (a sweep's merged one).
